route_text: {"target_smiles":"COc1cc(CCc2cc(Nc3ccnc(NCc4cc(C)no4)n3)n[nH]2)cc(OC)n1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线针对目标分子的高度模块化杂环特征，采用汇聚式策略进行逆合成拆分。首先切断连接吡唑环与吡嗪环的芳基C-N键，将其拆分为含2,6-二甲氧基吡啶侧链的氨基吡唑片段和取代的氯代吡嗪片段，该步可通过Buchwald-Hartwig偶联或芳香亲核取代（SNAr）高效实现。吡嗪片段由市售的2,5-二氯吡嗪与(5-甲基异噁唑-3-基)甲胺经高选择性SNAr反应一步制得。氨基吡唑片段则通过β-酮腈中间体与水合肼发生环化缩合反应构建吡唑环。β-酮腈中间体可通过3-(2,6-二甲氧基吡啶-4-基)丙酸乙酯与乙腈在强碱条件下的Claisen缩合制备，而该酯由2,6-二甲氧基异烟醛经Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons烯烃化及后续双键催化加氢还原平稳获得。全路线各起始原料均为商业易得的小分子单体，步骤高度汇聚且官能团兼容性好。","key_disconnection_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"Buchwald-Hartwig偶联与杂环模块化汇聚","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"COc1cc(CCc2cc(Nc3ccnc(NCc4cc(C)no4)n3)n[nH]2)cc(OC)n1","precursors":["COc1cc(CCc2cc(N)n[nH]2)cc(OC)n1","Cc1cc(CNc2nccc(Cl)n2)on1"],"reaction_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Cc1cc(CNc2nccc(Cl)n2)on1","precursors":["Clc1ccnc(Cl)n1","Cc1cc(CN)on1"],"reaction_class":"nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":3,"product":"COc1cc(CCc2cc(N)n[nH]2)cc(OC)n1","precursors":["COc1cc(CCC(=O)CC#N)cc(OC)n1","NN"],"reaction_class":"pyrazole synthesis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"COc1cc(CCC(=O)CC#N)cc(OC)n1","precursors":["CCOC(=O)CCc1cc(OC)nc(OC)c1","CC#N"],"reaction_class":"Claisen condensation"},{"step_id":5,"product":"CCOC(=O)CCc1cc(OC)nc(OC)c1","precursors":["CCOC(=O)C=Cc1cc(OC)nc(OC)c1","[H][H]"],"reaction_class":"hydrogenation"},{"step_id":6,"product":"CCOC(=O)C=Cc1cc(OC)nc(OC)c1","precursors":["COc1cc(C=O)cc(OC)n1","CCOC(=O)CP(=O)(OCC)OCC"],"reaction_class":"Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons reaction"}],"starting_materials":["CC#N","CCOC(=O)CP(=O)(OCC)OCC","COc1cc(C=O)cc(OC)n1","Cc1cc(CN)on1","Clc1ccnc(Cl)n1","NN","[H][H]"]}]}
